description: Byte-identical copies of avd-assess's foundation contract files (contracts/README.md there), from release `release`. Each must match the file at commit; `manifest` is the SHA-256 of the release's datapackage.json, vendored at assess/datapackage.json (tests/Facts.Tests.ps1 checks the hashes, tests/Assess.Tests.ps1 runs the verifier). Update the files, commit, release, manifest and the hashes in one PR.
